name: Divider
summary: A horizontal rule with a short label in the middle, such as "or continue with".
description: Use it to split two ways of doing the same thing, like a sign-in form and social sign-in buttons. For a plain rule with no label, use <hr>.

classes.name: v-divider
classes.description: Draws a line either side of its text, which sits in the middle in small muted type.

a11y: The label is ordinary text, so screen readers read it in place. Keep it meaningful ("or"), not decorative.
A plain <hr> is announced as a separator; use it when there is no label.

examples.title: Between two sign-in methods
examples.html: or
